name: Webex Channel
description: Cisco Webex messaging integration for OpenClaw

botWebhookUrl.description: Public URL for receiving Webex webhook POSTs under bot token

oauthWebhookUrl.description: Public URL for receiving Webex webhook POSTs under oAuth access token

webhookSecret.description: HMAC-SHA1 secret for verifying webhook signatures

allowFrom.description: Allowed sender emails or person IDs (dmPolicy: allowlisted)

collabAgentId.description: Agent ID used for message routing classification and processing spawns (gate/extract/summarize/respond). Configure this agent with a lightweight model in the host openclaw.json. Defaults to 'main'.

embeddingsAgentId.description: Agent ID whose `memorySearch` config the recall feature (v3 §9) resolves embeddings from. Defaults to collabAgentId's value if unset. For recall to work, this agent needs a `memorySearch` block configured in the host's agents.list[] entry — without it, recall embedding calls fail soft (logged, skipped) rather than crashing.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token for receiving all space messages

refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for renewing the access token
